unit by unit.

::: {.cp-course}
[B.Sc. (Hons) Statistics · Semester V]{.cp-level}

### [Econometrics](teaching/econometrics/index.qmd)

Generalized least squares, multicollinearity, heteroskedasticity, autocorrelation, instrumental
variables and simultaneous equations. Slides for all 60 lectures, unit by unit.

[Course page and slides](teaching/econometrics/index.qmd){.cp-go}
:::
:::

The complete lecture notes, solutions and assignments are shared with the students enrolled in each course.

## Workshops on R

I regularly give invited lectures and hands-on sessions on data analysis and statistical computing with R at workshops and faculty development programmes. Slides for these lectures are on the [Workshops](workshops.qmd) page; the R code and data are available on request.
